name: GSK3772701
sort_evidence: GSK3772701 is MMV367, a pyrrolidinamide antimalarial with no INN found, entering phase 2a in P. falciparum malaria (NCT07545681, not yet recruiting), and the book holds no row for it (https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42268935/).

trials.title: A Phase 2A Study of a Novel Antimalarial Pyrrolidinamide in Adult Patients With Uncomplicated P. Falciparum Malaria
Drug-Interaction Assessment of GSK3772701 in Healthy Male and Female Participants Aged 18 to 55 Years
